items.q: he had a -- he had a trio with Bob Crosby

ctx.x: Well Chuck she brought in New York, didn't you meet him, he used to work, Mildred brought him in from California, he had a -- he had a trio with Bob Crosby and ah -- oh, what's his name, I can't remember his name now, he was married to Lorraine Day for awhile, he was a pilot, he's an Alaskan pibt now, I understand. But they had a little trio in Los Angeles together.
